title: A hacker claims to have accessed Suno user info and source code, showing how it scraped music; Suno says no sensitive info was compromised in a November hack (Jason Koebler/404 Media)
summary: Jason Koebler / 404 Media: A hacker claims to have accessed Suno user info and source code, showing how it scraped music; Suno says no sensitive info was compromised in a November hack — Hacked source code reveals how Suno scraped decades worth of music and podcasts from the internet to train its AI tool.
